title: Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging
abstract: arXiv:2611.20078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. translated_title: 基于基础设施与注意力机制的多智能体强化学习用于高速公路匝道合流
translated_abstract: 匝道合流是高速公路上典型的安全与通行效率问题。在缺乏适当协调的情况下，人类驾驶员和自利的自动驾驶车辆可能做出危险的驾驶操作，从而引发事故或拥堵。随着协同自动驾驶车辆（CAV）和多智能体强化学习（MARL）的最新进展，可以对车辆进行训练以实现安全高效的合流协调。然而，在密集交通中，构建对交通状态的有效观测极具挑战性。例如，仅观测邻近车辆可能导致局部最优决策，而观测整个交通状况又会引入大量无关信息。本文提出了一种基于Transformer的MARL车辆控制模型来解决这些问题。路侧基础设施控制器通过车路协同（V2I）通信接收所有协同自动驾驶车辆的状态，并向它们回传控制指令。基于注意力的观测机制……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于Transformer注意力机制的路侧基础设施多智能体强化学习框架，通过V2I通信让路侧控制器聚合所有协同自动驾驶车辆的状态并下发控制指令，以在密集交通下实现安全高效的高速公路匝道合流。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transformer-based attention MARL framework in which a roadside infrastructure controller aggregates the states of all CAVs via V2I communication to enable safe and efficient highway ramp merging in dense traffic.
